result.summary: Reject wallet databases that lack a FLAGS record instead of treating them as legacy wallets. In addition, stop calling database loading logic during wallet creation in the `bitcoin-wallet` tool, writing the version records directly instead.
result.problem: Loading a SQLite wallet that lacks a FLAGS record causes the node to treat it as a legacy wallet, triggering an assert failure and crashing the node during `loadwallet` or at startup if the wallet is configured to autoload.
evidence: PR description: 'loadwallet on such a file aborts the node. If the wallet is in the load on startup list, the node aborts on every start.'
Author test results demonstrate that deleting the FLAGS record on master causes node aborts at `wallet.cpp:3577` or `wallet.cpp:3404`, whereas this PR returns RPC error -4 cleanly.
result.card: Reject SQLite wallets missing a FLAGS record with a graceful error instead of crashing the node. Missing FLAGS records previously caused the wallet loader to fall back to legacy handling and trigger unhandled assertions in SetupLegacyDataSPKM or LoadActiveScriptPubKeyMan, crashing the node on loadwallet or startup. The PR also adjusts bitcoin-wallet create so it no longer loads an empty database during creation.

risk.why: A flaw in wallet flag validation or wallet creation logic could cause valid wallets to fail to load or produce improperly initialized wallet files.
